|strategy=By [mailto:joea@decipher.com Joe Alread Decipher Intern]<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/endor/dark/small/alwaysthinkingwithyour.html</ref>

The days of draining with lone characters are over! This card and its Light Side counterpart will make players think differently about how they construct their mains and toys decks now and forever. EPP-based decks that usually drain with a lone character will have no way to combat this powerful card, unless they're running SAC. And with all the SAC counters that exist in the current environment, a player with the right cards can get this card to work whenever they want. Track your destinies correctly, get rid of the one big character that's present, then move in on your next turn and wipe out the rest.
